scenes.text:
CONCEPT: Minimalist travertine vanity
SETTING: Sunlit modern dressing room, morning.
SURFACE AND BACKGROUND: Honed beige travertine stone tabletop, smooth matte off-white plaster wall.
PRODUCT PRESENTATION: The necklace set rests flat on an inclined cream linen display pad positioned atop the stone.
COMPOSITION: Positioned along the lower-right third, leaving the upper-left open and clear.
CAMERA: 45-degree elevated angle, close focal distance.
LIGHTING: Raking natural morning sunlight from the left, soft diffused fills, clean contact shadows beneath jewelry edges.
COLOUR PALETTE: Warm beige, matte cream, soft sand. The lustrous metal and bright green accents detach cleanly from the pale stone.
PROPS: Small frosted glass perfume bottle blurred in background.
MOOD AND STYLE: Airy, architectural, understated luxury editorial.
